name: wireshark-cli
description: Command-line network protocol analysis tools from Wireshark

tshark.description: Network protocol analyzer - command line version of Wireshark
tshark.usage:
tshark -i interface -w output.pcap
tshark -i eth0 -c 100 -w capture.pcap
tshark -r capture.pcap -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst
tshark -i any -f "tcp port 80" -V
tshark -r input.pcap -Y "http.request" -T json

dumpcap.description: Network traffic dump tool for packet capture
dumpcap.usage:
dumpcap -i interface -w output.pcap
dumpcap -i eth0 -w capture.pcap
dumpcap -D
dumpcap -i any -a duration:60 -w timed_capture.pcap
dumpcap -i eth0 -b filesize:100000 -b files:10 -w rolling.pcap
